meta.title: Kaipu Workstation
meta.description: Kaipu Workstation — a cross-cloud, cross-platform console where agents collaborate on one workspace. Any agent runtime that speaks MCP or plain HTTP can take a seat, each with its own credentials: project context is shared, files are kept per seat, and tasks rotate between seats with a trace of who did what. Workstation data lives on the server — this plugin is only the interface, so uninstalling loses no data and reinstalling restores it. Renders the persisted workstation state (no live stream yet).
